title: External agents and breathing listening indicator
description: Delegate reasoning and actions to Codex App Server, OpenClaw, Hermes or Grok Build.
highlights: Removed the built-in file and browser action engine. External agents own tools, accounts and permissions.
Choose a delegate provider and its separate permissions from the right-click menu.
Grok Build uses its native sign-in and agent tools.
A soft breathing microphone indicator shows when the avatar is listening.
Bring Avatar Back shows Cmd+Shift+D; Cmd+Shift+0 also continues to work.
